item.title: What Is Prayer? If God Knows What We Need, Why Pray? | Prayer Series, Part 1
item.description:
If God already knows what we need, why pray at all? Prayer as service of the heart, whether daily prayer is a Torah or rabbinic obligation, why Ezra fixed a set text, the obligation of women, the four kinds of prayer, and how prayer changes the one who prays rather than HaShem.

item.title: Blessing the Blessed: The Surprising Origins of Our Morning Prayers | Prayer Series, Part 2
item.description:

item.title: Listen: Why Do We Cover Our Eyes for the Shema? | Prayer Series, Part 3
item.description:

item.title: Communal Meditation: Why Do We Repeat the Amidah? | Prayer Series, Part 4
item.description:

item.title: Creation, Revelation, Redemption: The Blessings Around the Shema | Prayer Series, 2024
item.description:
What do the blessings around the Shema teach? Until Barekhu the service is preparation, and the core is Barekhu, the Shema with its blessings, and the Amidah. The three blessings follow creation, revelation and redemption, and the Shema teaches that mercy and judgment both come from the One.

item.title: Standing Before God: The Seven Blessings of the Shabbat Amidah | Prayer Series, 2024
item.description:
How is the Shabbat Amidah built, blessing by blessing? The class draws the laws of the Amidah from its three names, covers standing and silent prayer learned from Hannah, and explains why the middle is a single blessing on the day's holiness. It then goes through the seven blessings.
